currentRoundInspection.scope: Würzburg Residence complete connected palace exterior on its actual relation outline: open western Ehrenhof and four fully open mapped inner courtyards; long sandstone garden range with central taller pavilion, steep slate roofs and two curved outer roof masses, western wing-end pediments, repeated three-level glazing/cornices, triple western and garden entrances, physical front columns and recessed side colonnades. Low dormers, balustrades, restrained original abstract roof figures and small verdigris turret carry the photographed identity. Gardens/fountain, separate town buildings and interiors remain outside this building model. No copied sculpture, frescoes, text or interior decoration.
